components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Single primary call to action per surface such as Save changes, Add rule, or Retry connection.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: #c5492e; color: #ffffff; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: transform 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: #b94027; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b94027; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary & Danger Buttons
components.description: Outlined pill buttons for standard actions and reversible destructive actions like Discard changes.
components.css: .ds-btn-row { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-btn-secondary, .ds-btn-danger { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 999px; background: #ffffff; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: transform 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary { border: 1px solid #80827a; color: #252624; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e9e9e5; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-danger { border: 1px solid #a64d4f; color: #b83238; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #fcf4f4; border-color: #b83238; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible, .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b94027; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: URL Input Field
components.description: 44px minimum-height text input with high-contrast control stroke and clear focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; width: 280px; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; } .ds-label { font-size: 13px; color: #62645f; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #80827a; border-radius: 14px; color: #252624; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #62645f; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b94027; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: Tactile 44x28px pill switch used for App behavior and macOS Login Item toggles.
components.css: .ds-toggle-group { display: inline-flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; } .ds-switch { width: 44px; height: 28px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #62645f; background: #767872; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 3px 7px rgba(37,38,36,0.06); transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-switch-on { background: #c5492e; border-color: transparent; } .ds-thumb { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(37,38,36,0.16); transition: transform 160ms ease; } .ds-switch-on .ds-thumb { transform: translateX(16px); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b94027; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation Rail
components.description: Dark graphite 84px capsule navigation rail with 40px circular active icon disc and terracotta active icon ink.
components.html: HomeRules
components.css: .ds-rail { width: 84px; padding: 16px 4px; border-radius: 42px; background: linear-gradient(170deg, #666762, #3c3d39); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.15); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; } .ds-rail-item { width: 76px; padding: 8px 0; border-radius: 20px; color: #f0f0ec; text-decoration: none; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.15; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: rgba(25, 26, 23, 0.22); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-rail-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-rail-active { color: #ffffff; font-weight: 500; } .ds-rail-active .ds-rail-icon { background: #ffffff; color: #b94027; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(24,25,22,0.12); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: Three-option segmented pill for System, Light, and Dark appearance selection inside Preferences.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e9e9e5; border: 1px solid rgba(37,38,36,0.14); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px rgba(37,38,36,0.06); font-family: Figtree, sans-serif; } .ds-seg-opt { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: #62645f; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-seg-opt:hover { color: #252624; } .ds-seg-active { background: #ffffff; border-color: #80827a; color: #252624; box-shadow: 0 3px 7px rgba(37,38,36,0.06); } .ds-seg-opt:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b94027; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Browsify is a local-first macOS desktop utility presented as a calm, tactile desk instrument rather than a sprawling SaaS dashboard. Every screen sits inside a grounded, warm-stone window frame anchored by a dark graphite navigation rail on the left and clean porcelain work panels on the right. The interface favors immediate legibility, direct manipulation, and predictable macOS conventions—giving technical and everyday Mac users confidence that clicking any link opens the exact browser and profile they expect.

The aesthetic rejects generic neon-purple AI gradients, decorative glass blur, uppercase eyebrow kickers, and marketing chrome. Color stays quiet until it carries operational meaning: warm stone neutrals absorb visual noise, terracotta marks the single primary action or active route, and semantic tones (crimson, amber, moss) appear strictly for errors, unsaved drafts, and verified readiness. Both Light and Dark themes preserve this material contrast, shifting from sunlit warm paper to low-glare olive-charcoal without altering layout geometry or hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Warm stone and porcelain surfaces paired with a single dark graphite navigation rail for instant spatial orientation.
One terracotta accent voice reserved for primary calls to action, active toggles, and active navigation focus.
Concentric rounded geometry stepping down cleanly from the outer desktop frame (`38px`) to cards (`24px`), inputs (`14px`), and tactile pill buttons (`999px`).
Accessible, unhurried interaction geometry: every interactive button, toggle target, select, and link meets a `44px` minimum hit height with unmistakable focus rings.
Local-first transparency: explicit connection status, staged Config Draft save/discard footers, and dry-run URL testing that never opens a browser by surprise.

rules.name: The One Accent Voice Rule
rules.body: Terracotta (`#c5492e` / `#f28a6b`) is used strictly for the single primary action, active route, or enabled toggle—never for decorative gradients, card fills, or secondary icons.

rules.name: The Interactive Stroke Rule
rules.body: Every interactive input, select, secondary button, and segmented thumb uses `Control Stroke` (`#80827a` / `#8e9085`) to guarantee ≥ 3:1 non-text contrast; disabled controls step down to `--browsify-border-strong` so unavailable controls visibly recede without collapsing contrast on labels.

rules.name: The Neutral Stone Rule
rules.body: Never introduce cold pure-gray (`#808080`) or pure-black (`#000000`) surfaces; all neutral surfaces carry Browsify's subtle warm-olive undertone (`#252624` through `#fbfbfa`).

rules.name: The Zero-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Never place tiny uppercase kicker/eyebrow labels above headings; lead directly with the clear sentence-case heading and a concise subtitle when needed.

rules.name: The Tabular Metric Rule
rules.body: All counts, rule numbers, log timestamps, and version numbers apply `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so numbers align cleanly and never jitter when live data updates.

rules.name: The Tracking Floor Rule
rules.body: Tightened display tracking never goes below `-0.035em` (and never below `-0.04em` anywhere), preserving letter separation in `Sora` across macOS Retina and standard displays.

rules.name: The Flat-Inside-Cards Rule
rules.body: Never nest bordered, shadowed cards inside another `.glass-panel` card; subdivide content inside a panel using `1px` hairline dividers (`--browsify-border-strong`) or subtle flat inset fills.

rules.name: The Calm Motion Rule
rules.body: Interactive lifts stay restrained (`translateY(-1px)` on fine-pointer hover, `translateY(1px) scale(0.985)` on active press, `140ms`–`160ms ease`), and every transform and transition collapses cleanly under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.

dos: Do preserve the pinned `1080px × 760px` desktop `.app-frame` dimensions and `84px` graphite capsule navigation rail so Browsify keeps its focused desktop-instrument proportions.
Do use `Control Stroke` (`#80827a` light / `#8e9085` dark) on every interactive border and `Terracotta Ink` (`#b94027` light / `#ff9c7f` dark) for links, active rail labels, and `2px` focus rings.
Do keep `44px` minimum height on every button, input, select, link action, and interactive list item, and preserve `prefers-reduced-motion` parity.
Do use canonical Browsify domain terms (`Primary Config`, `Config Draft`, `Handler Rule`, `Rewrite Rule`, `Browser Target`, `Opener`, `Unavailable Destination`) across all labels and feedback copy.
Do group immediate macOS/window controls (`This Mac & app`) separately from draft-staged `Primary Config` controls so users always know whether `Save changes` is required.
Do render a single calm disconnected `.glass-panel` with reopen steps (`Applications`, `Spotlight`, or `browsify ui`) and one primary `Retry connection` button on offline subpages.
donts: Don't add tiny uppercase eyebrow/kicker labels above page or section headings.
Don't nest bordered or shadowed cards inside `.glass-panel` containers; use `1px` dividers (`--browsify-border-strong`) instead.
Don't apply `opacity` to a parent label around a disabled `<Toggle>` or `<button>`, which compounds dimming and breaks WCAG AA text contrast.
Don't use a bottom `mask-image` fade on scrollable containers that slices the last visible line of text on mobile viewports.
Don't hijack macOS `Option+Arrow` text navigation inside `<input>`, `<select>`, or `<textarea>` fields for keyboard rule reordering.
Don't introduce secondary brand accents, saturated hero gradients, or marketing copy inside the desktop utility workspace.
